{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
#FLUX: --queue=qcpu_exp

# The Slurm -A (--account) directive has no direct equivalent in Flux.
# Account/project information is often handled by site-specific configurations.
# Omission of this directive may lead to the job being charged to a default account.

#FLUX: --ntasks=1
#FLUX: --comment="use:vtune=2022.2.0"
#FLUX: --time=0:10:00

# The Slurm '--mail-type' directive has no direct equivalent in Flux and has been omitted.
# Omission of these directives means the user will not receive email notifications about job status changes.

#FLUX: --job-name=AVS-vtune

cd $FLUX_JOB_WORKDIR

ml intel-compilers/2022.1.0 CMake/3.23.1-GCCcore-11.3.0 VTune/2022.2.0-intel-2021b

[ -d build_vtune ] && rm -rf build_vtune
[ -d build_vtune ] || mkdir build_vtune
cd build_vtune

CC=icc CXX=icpc cmake ..
make

for threads in 18 36; do
    for builder in "ref" "loop" "tree"; do
        rm -rf vtune-${builder}-${threads}
        vtune -collect threading -r vtune-${builder}-${threads} -app-working-dir . -- ./PMC --builder ${builder} -t ${threads} --grid 128 ../data/bun_zipper_res3.pts
    done
done
"
}
